_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process; harness/descriptive_examples.test.py derives these from the generator's constants and requires them to match

agreement.claim: both engines report the same summaries, quartiles and standardized differences
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten decimals on every key. harness/descriptive_examples.test.py checks every value against Python's statistics module (a third implementation) and shows the two traps move numbers by more than the tolerance: the n divisor changes the age SD, and type 6 quartiles differ from type 7.

recovery.claim: each summary is close to the value the fixture was built with

calibration.rule: each tolerance is about 1.3 times its measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: At n = 600 the diabetes SMD's sampling spread (99th percentile miss 0.218) is as large as the SMD itself (0.2195), so recovery cannot tell a correct diabetes SMD from zero; agreement and the statistics-module oracle are what check it. Measured by harness/descriptive_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
